verdict_reason: A useful shared stub-listing helper, but its page size and seed name each duplicate a value held elsewhere and it is missing from the testing.md helper catalogue.

todos.issue: listedStubNames hard-codes pageSize: 8 (address-book-stub.js:8) while address-book.test.js:34 declares const PAGE_SIZE = 8 for the same stub listing, and its own tests assert 'four pages of 8' against it: two homes for one page size, and the helper's cap is invisible at its call sites (a stub list longer than 8 is silently cut to the first page).
todos.fix: Must: the stub-listing page size used by stub-mode service tests has one owner that the helper and address-book.test.js both read. One way: export a STUB_LIST_PAGE_SIZE from address-book-stub.js, use it as listedStubNames' pageSize and import it in address-book.test.js in place of the local PAGE_SIZE.

todos.issue: address-book-stub.js is a new shared helper (STUB_SEED_ADDRESS_NAME, listedStubNames) used by address-book.test.js and address-book.roles.test.js, but the test-helpers catalogue in src/server/app/docs/testing.md lists every other file in common/test-helpers and does not mention it, so the next stub-mode test re-derives the seed name and the listing call locally.
todos.fix: Must: testing.md's common/test-helpers catalogue lists address-book-stub.js and what each export gives. One way: add an entry beside capture-info-logs.js (testing.md:120).

todos.issue: STUB_SEED_ADDRESS_NAME = 'Stub Farm 1' (address-book-stub.js:3) is a second home for the stub seed's name, already written as seedAddress.name = 'Stub Farm 1' in src/server/app/features/address-book/fit/seed-address.js:3; both describe the address stub.js builds as buildSeedAddress(1).
todos.fix: Must: the stub seed address's name has one owner in test support that the unit-test helper and the FIT seed both read. One way: have seed-address.js take its name from STUB_SEED_ADDRESS_NAME (or the reverse).
